arcs.heading: A smaller proposal, still awaiting approval
arcs.text:
The repair-grant proposal narrowed this week without becoming an adopted program. Staff replaced the initial $12 million draft with a recommended $4 million pilot limited to two service areas. That changed the scale and geographic scope under consideration; it did not authorize grants.

At Wednesday’s hearing, speakers disagreed over the two-area limit, and no vote occurred. Those speakers’ views do not establish wider resident opinion. At the Friday cutoff, the available record still leaves the pilot as a recommendation, with approval unresolved.
